analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($696.70) vs SMA5 ($704.07)/SMA20 ($705.54)/SMA50 ($696.98): trading below short-term/mid-term, confirming mid-term resistance.
· Position vs SMA100 ($685.90)/SMA200 ($653.89): trading above long-term trend, confirming support.
· 52-week Position (85.7%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (52.1 → 44.2): entering oversold territory, continued downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.2828 → -1.4808): worsening, indicating continued weakness.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $696.59): approaching lower band, testing support.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($679.73): based on Pivot S2, next support level on further decline.
· Swing Resistance ($699.15): based on 5-day high, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower Low / Lower Low): confirming continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.59x): surge in volume, adding conviction to the downward move.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Continued Downtrend): maintain wait-and-see, monitor support on further declines.
